description: Regex patterns for routing extracted claims to the correct verifier (rule engine vs web search vs refused vs inferred). Applied after LLM extraction, before verification. Chinese + English bilingual coverage.
priority: first-match-wins, ordered from most specific to least specific

authority_rules.name: arxiv_id
authority_rules.description: arXiv paper identifier

authority_rules.name: doi
authority_rules.description: DOI identifier

authority_rules.name: github_pr_slash
authority_rules.description: GitHub PR reference via /owner/repo#number format

authority_rules.name: github_pr_symbol
authority_rules.description: GitHub PR reference via #number format (requires context), Chinese + English
authority_rules.extract: pr_number (g1), repo extracted from surrounding context or document metadata

authority_rules.name: github_issue
authority_rules.description: GitHub Issue reference, Chinese + English

authority_rules.name: gitlab_mr
authority_rules.description: GitLab Merge Request reference via URL
authority_rules.note: GitLab !N shortcut matched by code_platform_symbol pattern below.

authority_rules.name: gitlab_issue
authority_rules.description: GitLab Issue reference via URL

authority_rules.name: code_platform_symbol_pr
authority_rules.description: Generic code platform PR/MR reference via symbol (!N / #N) — platform inferred from context
authority_rules.extract: number (g1), platform inferred from document metadata
authority_rules.note: Matches both GitHub #n and GitLab !n. When preceded by domain-specific patterns, those win.

authority_rules.name: gitlab_repo
authority_rules.description: GitLab repository via URL
authority_rules.note: Before github_repo to prevent domain-gated GitLab URLs from being routed to gh CLI.

authority_rules.name: gitee_repo
authority_rules.description: Gitee repository via URL
authority_rules.note: Before github_repo. Gitee uses REST API (no CLI).

authority_rules.name: github_repo
authority_rules.description: GitHub repository via github.com URL (no bare owner/repo matching)
authority_rules.note: Only matches github.com/owner/repo URLs. Bare owner/repo references (without github.com/) are NOT matched — they fall through to web_search.

authority_rules.name: url
authority_rules.description: URL reference

authority_rules.name: npm_package
authority_rules.description: NPM package reference via install command, Chinese + English
authority_rules.note: Catches both English CLI (install/i) and Chinese (安装/装). Non-install mentions fall through to web_search.

authority_rules.name: pypi_package
authority_rules.description: PyPI package reference via pip install command, Chinese + English
authority_rules.note: Catches both English CLI (install/download) and Chinese (安装/装). pypi.org URLs caught by url rule.

authority_rules.name: cargo_crate
authority_rules.description: Cargo crate reference via install command or crates.io URL, Chinese + English
authority_rules.note: Catches both English CLI (install/add) and Chinese (安装/添加/装). Pure crates.io URL caught by url rule.

authority_rules.name: go_module
authority_rules.description: Go module reference via go get or pkg.go.dev URL, Chinese + English
authority_rules.note: Allows optional Chinese bridging words (拉取/获取/安装) between 'go get' and the module path.

authority_rules.name: nuget_package
authority_rules.description: NuGet package reference via install or nuget.org URL, Chinese + English
examples: 通过 NuGet 安装 Microsoft.ML
authority_rules.note: Catches both English CLI (Install-Package/dotnet add) and Chinese (NuGet 安装/通过 NuGet 安装).

authority_rules.name: git_commit
authority_rules.description: Git commit hash reference, Chinese + English
authority_rules.note: Requires repo context (owner/repo) from document metadata or preceding github_repo match.

authority_rules.name: rfc
authority_rules.description: RFC document reference

authority_rules.name: pmid
authority_rules.description: PubMed ID (PMID) reference

authority_rules.name: patent
authority_rules.description: Patent number (US/CN/WO/EP/JP/KR)

authority_rules.name: ietf_draft
authority_rules.description: IETF Internet-Draft reference
authority_rules.note: IETF Internet-Drafts are distinct from RFCs. Use RFC pattern for published RFCs.

authority_rules.name: docker_image
authority_rules.description: Docker image reference via CLI command, Chinese + English
authority_rules.note: Catches both English (pull/run) and Chinese (拉取/运行/启动) CLI references. Matches single-segment (nginx) and org/image (library/nginx) names. hub.docker.com URLs caught by url rule.

authority_rules.name: spdx_license
authority_rules.description: SPDX license identifier in license declaration context
authority_rules.extract: license_id (g1), validated against SPDX license list
authority_rules.note: Removed bare 使用/采用 as triggers — too generic in Chinese (matches 'uses Node.js' etc). License context required via 许可证 or English license phrases.

authority_rules.name: git_tag
authority_rules.description: Git tag reference (lightweight, non-release), Chinese + English
authority_rules.note: Catches both English CLI (git tag) and Chinese (打 tag/标记 tag). Requires repo context. GitHub Release tags caught by version rule.

judgment_rules.name: opinion_value
judgment_rules.description: Pure first-person value judgments — inherently non-verifiable
judgment_rules.note: These patterns are first-person evaluations, not attributable to a named source

judgment_rules.name: opinion_attribution
judgment_rules.description: Community consensus claims — verifiable that someone said it (T3)
judgment_rules.note: Verifies that the attribution exists, not that the underlying claim is true

judgment_rules.name: opinion_vague
judgment_rules.description: Claims too vague or speculative to verify, without verifiable atoms
judgment_rules.note: Pure speculation without searchable content — not useful to verify

judgment_rules.name: hedging_factual
judgment_rules.description: Hedged factual claims — verifiable but low confidence, NOT refused
judgment_rules.note: Routed to web_search only if claim also contains searchable entities (numbers, proper names, URLs, technical terms). Guard checks against authority_rules + relationship_rules patterns. If no verifiable atoms found → REFUSED.

interpretation_rules.name: interpretation_causal
interpretation_rules.description: Causal inference claims — source data exists but the inference itself is not directly verifiable
interpretation_rules.note: Claims that draw conclusions from source data. Source data may be verifiable (→ SUPPORTED), but the derived conclusion cannot be directly proven by external evidence. Separate from REFUSED: these are NOT pure value judgments.

interpretation_rules.name: interpretation_significance
interpretation_rules.description: Significance/importance claims — subjective assessment of impact
interpretation_rules.note: Claims about the importance or significance of a fact. The fact itself may be verifiable, but its 'importance' is the author's interpretation.

relationship_rules.name: benchmark_data
relationship_rules.description: Performance benchmark claims with numerical data

fallback.description: Any claim not matched by authority, judgment, or interpretation rules defaults here
fallback.note: Relationship-type claims are the default bucket for anything that doesn't match the above rules
